payload_en.headline: Republican midterm losses trigger White House staff shakeup under Donald Trump

paragraphs.text: Donald Trump replaced X Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller following Republican losses in the 2026 midterm elections.
On Friday, Trump announced that Miller would replace Wiles as White House chief of staff.
Last week, Trump had said there was zero chance he would replace Wiles.
On election night on Tuesday, Trump blamed Wiles for the historic Republican midterms defeat in front of others.
On Saturday 7 November 2026, Wiles will move to Trump's political operation.
Wiles was the first woman to serve as White House chief of staff.
Miller would replace Wiles as White House Chief of Staff.
On Thursday, Harmeet Dhillon resigned from her position in the Justice Department.
On Friday, Trump picked him to become the next White House Chief of Staff.
He has been one of the most influential figures in Trump's inner circle since the 2016 election campaign.
Miller is a deeply ideological Trump loyalist and the architect of some of the most polarizing domestic policies in Trump's second term.
He is likely to steer Trump away from seeking deals with Democrats after Tuesday's losses.
He has been the architect of radical domestic policies in Trump's second term.
On Friday, Trump announced the staffing change.
On November Trump announced a shake-up in his White House.
On Friday, Trump ousted Wiles from the role of White House chief of staff.
On Saturday 7 November Wiles's departure and the ascent of Miller will fundamentally shift the circle of advisers around the president as the White House absorbs the shock of the midterm elections.
Wiles is the highest-ranking White House official to leave in the wake of the midterm elections.
Miller has amassed considerable power in the second Trump administration.
He has continued to serve as a fiery surrogate for the president’s most divisive moves.
Miller responded to his elevation with a post on X.
The decision (and Mr) to replace Wiles is set to take effect on Monday.
Trump distanced himself from the midterm loss.
Trump has not accepted blame for the election results.

Trump pleaded with his supporters at campaign rallies to pretend he was on the ballot, and voters delivered a decisive rebuke of Trump's handling of the economy, the war with Iran, and the aggressive deportation campaign directed by Miller.
The Republican wipeout has inflamed tensions within the administration (Small Business Administration).
Miller's pitch for the chief of staff job was that Trump needed to wind down the Iran war, a conflict viewed as a betrayal by the president's core supporters.
The midterm elections cost Republicans their majorities in the House and Senate.
Wiles was the first woman to hold the top staff job in the West Wing and helped steer Trump to his election victory in 2024.
Attorney General Pam Bondi, Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer, Homeland Security Secretary Kristi L. Kristi L Noem, and Director of National Intelligence Tulsi Gabbard were replaced by men.

Miller said the administration was considering suspending the constitutional mechanism that allows detainees to challenge their confinement in court, and wrote on X that the mission now is to "Fight with all of our soul to support our President and defend this magnificent Republic."
Miller also said the first priority was to "turn off the faucet" of new arrivals.
Miller said "We are being conquered" and that "we live in a world, in the real world, Jake, that is governed by strength, that is governed by force, that is governed by power."
Miller praised Trump as "the most transformative political leader in American History" and said he had saved America from those who would destroy it.

Trump said that he "wanted to make a change" and that "Stephen’s been with me from the beginning. He gets it", while also thanking Wiles for her service as Chief of Staff by stating, "I want to thank her for her service as Chief of Staff — Trump has done a great job!"
Wiles would continue working for Trump's political organisation.
Wiles confirmed her departure and stated in a post on X that "Trump in the White House has been the honour of a lifetime".
Former Republican Congressman Matt Gaetz celebrated the announcement, declaring, "IT’S MILLER TIME".

Incoming House Majority Leader Representative Hakeem Jeffries criticised the decision to appoint Miller, calling him a dangerous xenophobe and reckless extremist who has American blood on his hands, and said that a dangerous xenophobe should have been fired instead.
Trump's eight female cabinet-level officials resigned or were fired earlier this year.
Miller, 41, has worked for Trump since his first presidential campaign.

वाइल्स वेस्ट विंग में शीर्ष स्टाफ नौकरी संभालने वाली पहली महिला थीं और उन्होंने 2024 में ट्रंप को उनकी चुनावी जीत तक पहुंचाने में मदद की।
अटॉर्नी जनरल पाम बॉन्डी, लेबर सेक्रेटरी लोरी शावेज-डेरेमेर, होमलैंड सुरक्षा सेक्रेटरी क्रिस्टी एल नोएम, और नेशनल इंटेलिजेंस की डायरेक्टर तुलसी गैबार्ड को पुरुषों द्वारा बदल दिया गया।

मिलर ने कहा कि एडमिनिस्ट्रेशन उस संवैधानिक तंत्र को निलंबित करने पर विचार कर रहा है जो बंदियों को अदालत में अपनी कैद को चुनौती देने की अनुमति देता है, और एक्स पर लिखा कि मिशन अब "हमारे राष्ट्रपति का समर्थन करने और इस शानदार रिपब्लिक की रक्षा करने के लिए अपनी पूरी आत्मा के साथ लड़ना है।"
मिलर ने यह भी कहा कि पहली प्राथमिकता नए आगमन के "नल को बंद करना" थी।
मिलर ने कहा "हम पर विजय प्राप्त की जा रही है" और यह कि "जेक, हम एक ऐसी दुनिया में रहते हैं, वास्तविक दुनिया में, जो ताकत द्वारा शासित है, जो बल द्वारा शासित है, जो शक्ति द्वारा शासित है।"
मिलर ने ट्रंप की "अमेरिकी इतिहास में सबसे परिवर्तनकारी राजनीतिक नेता" के रूप में प्रशंसा की और कहा कि उन्होंने अमेरिका को उन लोगों से बचाया है जो इसे नष्ट कर देते।

ट्रंप ने कहा कि वह "बदलाव लाना चाहते थे" और यह कि "स्टीफन शुरुआत से मेरे साथ रहे हैं। वह इसे समझते हैं", साथ ही चीफ ऑफ स्टाफ के रूप में उनकी सेवा के लिए वाइल्स को धन्यवाद देते हुए कहा, "मैं चीफ ऑफ स्टाफ के रूप में उनकी सेवा के लिए उन्हें धन्यवाद देना चाहता हूँ — ट्रंप ने बहुत अच्छा काम किया है!"
वाइल्स ट्रंप के राजनीतिक संगठन के लिए काम करना जारी रखेंगी।
वाइल्स ने अपनी विदाई की पुष्टि की और एक्स पर एक पोस्ट में कहा कि "व्हाइट हाउस में ट्रंप जीवन भर का सम्मान रहा है।"
पूर्व रिपब्लिकन कांग्रेसमैन मैट गेट्स ने घोषणा का जश्न मनाया, और घोषित किया, "इट्स मिलर टाइम"।

इनकमिंग हाउस मेजोरिटी लीडर प्रतिनिधि हकीम जेफ्रीज ने मिलर को नियुक्त करने के फैसले की आलोचना की, उन्हें एक खतरनाक ज़ेनोफोब और लापरवाह चरमपंथी बताया जिसके हाथों पर अमेरिकी खून है, और कहा कि इसके बजाय एक खतरनाक ज़ेनोफोब को बर्खास्त किया जाना चाहिए था।
ट्रंप के आठ महिला कैबिनेट-स्तरीय अधिकारियों ने इस साल की शुरुआत में इस्तीफा दे दिया या उन्हें बर्खास्त कर दिया गया।
मिलर, 41, ने ट्रंप के लिए उनके पहले राष्ट्रपति अभियान से काम किया है।
